scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Amol, chala tumchi English practice karu. Where are you going?
Amol says: I go to home.
Miss Nova says: Tumhala mhanaycha ahe, 'I am going home'. 'Go to' he places sathi vapartat, pan 'home' sathi 'to' chi garaj naste.
Amol says: Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry.
Miss Nova says: 'I am in a hurry' he mhannyacha correct way ahe.
Amol says: Okay, thank you.

Amol says: Wait, tumhi kon ahat? Ani mazya car madhe tumhi mala kashi correct karat ahat?
Miss Nova says: Mi ahe Miss Nova, tumchi personal AI teacher, Supernova AI var. Mi tumcha exact level analyze karte ani phakta tumchyasathi ek personalized plan banavte.
Amol says: Pan jar mi silly mistakes kelya tar? Mala khup shy feel hota.
Miss Nova says: Ithe tumhala konihi baghat nahiye ani judge pan karat nahiye. Hazaro mistakes kara, mi tumhala kadhihi na hasata correct karen.
